notes:
Passed on the fake backend with python3 -m mhs.driver check (evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level). Model-authored and unreviewed; no hardware backend, no hardware run and no human review. The package binds one of the repository's registered environments, MoDe-Spot-Bend-v0 (task/Bend/__init__.py:11-13, SpotBendRodEnv at task/Bend/spot_bend_env.py:121); the other eleven registered MoDe-* ids are not covered by this package. The fake backend is a pure Python kinematic stand-in (fake.py): Isaac Sim 4.2.0 and Isaac Lab are not installed where the gate runs, so the sim backend (gymnasium.make) was not run and the fake was never compared with the upstream environment. The clone does not define the action Box bounds (Isaac Lab's DirectRLEnv is outside the clone), so the fake uses marked placeholder bounds of -1 to 1 per component; the bridge publishes those as the derived action.values limit with provenance 'MoDe-Spot-Bend-v0:action_space' in reference.json, and no authored Limit or Fact claims that bound. Expected warnings: G6.NO_NATIVE_CALL for cap.world.seed.v1 (the seed only sets the seed of the next reset and makes no native call); five G7.MAYBE_ABSENT for the Gymnasium interface inherited from DirectRLEnv outside the clone (action_space, observation_space, reset, step, close); and four G8.NO_UNIT for ticks, action.values and the two seed inputs the bridge derives. No catalogue extension id is used, so there are no catalogue_requests. gate.digest is the digest the check printed (the check report without its clock); check-report.json is regenerated by every gate run and is not part of the package.
